# @remix-pwa/cache

> 标签: cache, pwa, remix, remix-pwa, remix-run, service worker, sw

## 简介

A thin-layered wrapper around the browser's Cache Storage API that supercharges your Remix PWA's caching capabilities.

## 官网

- 官网：https://remix-pwa.run
- 源码仓库：git+ssh://git@github.com/remix-pwa/monorepo.git
- npm 页面：https://www.npmjs.com/package/@remix-pwa/cache
